info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Chemical Environment API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: chemenv_iucr
params.description: A comma delimited string list of unique (cationic) species in IUCR format.

params.name: chemenv_iupac
params.description: A comma delimited string list of unique (cationic) species in IUPAC format.

params.name: chemenv_name
params.description: A comma delimited string list of coordination environment descriptions for unique (cationic) species.

params.name: chemenv_symbol
params.description: A comma delimited string list of ChemEnv symbols for unique (cationic) species in the structure.

params.name: species
params.description: A comma delimited string list of unique (cationic) species in the structure.

params.name: csm_min
params.description: Minimum value of the continous symmetry measure for any site.

params.name: csm_max
params.description: Maximum value of the continous symmetry measure for any site.

params.name: elements
params.description: Query by elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: exclude_elements
params.description: Query by excluded elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: nsites_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of nsites

params.name: nsites_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of nsites

params.name: nsites
params.description: Query for nsites being equal to an exact value

params.name: nsites_not_eq
params.description: Query for nsites being not equal to an exact value

params.name: nsites_eq_any
params.description: Query for nsites being any of these values. Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: nsites_neq_any
params.description: Query for nsites being not any of these values.                             Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: nelements_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of nelements

params.name: nelements_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of nelements

params.name: nelements
params.description: Query for nelements being equal to an exact value

params.name: nelements_not_eq
params.description: Query for nelements being not equal to an exact value

params.name: nelements_eq_any
params.description: Query for nelements being any of these values. Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: nelements_neq_any
params.description: Query for nelements being not any of these values.                             Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: volume_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of volume

params.name: volume_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of volume

params.name: density_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of density

params.name: density_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of density

params.name: density_atomic_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of density_atomic

params.name: density_atomic_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of density_atomic

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from ChemEnvDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `builder_meta` `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `material_id` `deprecated` `deprecation_reasons` `last_updated` `origins` `warnings` `structure` `property_name` `valences` `species` `chemenv_symbol` `chemenv_iupac` `chemenv_iucr` `chemenv_name` `chemenv_name_with_alternatives` `csm` `method` `mol_from_site_environments` `wyckoff_positions`

params.name: _all_fields
params.description: Include all fields.
